public.text: Test specifications do not establish product conformance — Prevents procurement from treating a server's general standards claim as proof of correct ICD-11 support. Apply together with A09.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace bullet; apply B03.02 and coordinate with A09.01: • Standardised components may have reusable test specifications and tools. Where an implementation claims a standardised actor or interface, the adopter should reuse the applicable test plans, simulators, and reference data where these exist. The actual product version, configuration, terminology releases, and deployment integrations still require verification. A published standard or available test suite is not evidence that the deployed component conforms.
